proposal.reason: Primary change is communicator-level configuration control: new config fields, validation/defaults, env overrides, and cross-rank propagation for nChannelsPerNetPeer/graphUsageMode/maxP2pPeers (plus nvlinkCentricSched storage). Add enqueue because runtime submission behavior changes in strong-stream graph/non-graph handling and P2P plan/channel batching logic. Add device-topology because src/graph/paths.cc now changes topology/path-based per-peer P2P channel derivation and applies max-peer/args-budget channel capping rules.
